methods.description: Subtract given quartiles or sort and use medians of lower/upper halves, leaving out only an odd middle value.
Compare extreme spread with middle-half spread and use smaller IQR for more consistent middle-half data.
Recalculate quartiles and compare range/IQR when adding a value; less affected does not mean always unchanged.
Find a missing quartile by reversing Q3-Q1; missing ordered score also uses current published prerequisite worked-example route.

sourceReview.excerpt:
6.  Consider the scores 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6, 7, 8.

A score of 23 is added to the dataset. How will this affect the IQR?

IQR is unchanged, remains at 3.

> Hence, describe why the IQR is more useful than the range when there
> are outliers.

The range increases from 6 to 21. The IQR is more useful because it
measures spread of the middle 50% of data, so outliers do not affect it.
